nodes.title: Vicky Pollard Face Mask – Fancy Dress Cardboard Costume Mask
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Bring a famous face to a stag or hen do with this Vicky Pollard face mask, printed on sturdy card and cut to shape. Pair it with a costume, or keep it simple and let the comedian face do the talking.

Vicky Pollard Card Face Mask for Parties

Printed in full colour on 350gsm silk card and cut to shape, the mask comes with the eye holes already cut out, plus elastic and sticky tabs for a quick fit. Want a mask of someone who isn't in our range, like the birthday boy or the bride-to-be? We can make one from your photo.

Why you'll love it

  • Pre-cut eye holes, with elastic and sticky tabs included
  • Full-colour digital print for a sharp, recognisable face
  • Posted flat in a board-backed envelope to keep it crease-free
  • Full A4 size (297 x 210 mm), so it covers an adult face
  • An easy, cheap way to theme a stag or hen do

Size & details

  • Size: 297 x 210 mm (A4), a full adult-size face
  • Material: 350gsm silk card, full-colour digital print
  • Finish: semi-waterproof
  • Fit: one size for adults; elastic and sticky tabs included
  • Pre-cut eye holes; cut to the shape of the face
  • Packaging: board-backed envelope

Delivery

Printed in our UK workshop and posted to you. Dispatch and postage options are shown at checkout.

Order one for a comedy night, or buy a few so the whole group can turn up as Vicky Pollard.

This is an unofficial novelty product made for fun and fancy dress. Vicky Pollard has not endorsed, sponsored or approved this product, and Foxy Printing has no connection with them. The name is used only to describe the design.

nodes.title: David Walliams Face Mask – Fancy Dress Cardboard Costume Mask
nodes.descriptionHtml:
The Perfect Fancy Dress Party Face Mask

When it comes to fancy dress parties, the right accessories can make or break your outfit. Whether you're dressing up in costume or simply want to pay homage to this talented Comedian, this facemask is guaranteed to impress.

Lightweight and Comfortable

One of the key features of this facemask is its lightweight construction. Made from high-quality cardboard, it is comfortable to wear for extended periods. You won't have to worry about discomfort or irritation ruining your night. The elastic ensures a secure fit, keeping the mask in place throughout your festivities.

Lifelike Likeness

The attention to detail in the design of this facemask is truly remarkable. Friends and fellow party-goers will be amazed by your striking resemblance to the iconic Comedian.

Affordable and Accessible

In a world where quality often comes at a high price, our Cardboard Party Facemasks offer exceptional value for money. With its affordable price tag, it is accessible to fans of all budgets. You can look like a TV star without breaking the bank!

Conclusion

With its incredible likeness, lightweight construction, and affordable price, it ticks all the boxes for a perfect fancy dress party mask. Be the envy of your friends and make a lasting impression at your next event. Order yours today and get ready to turn heads!

We can also print your own face or a friend's face, simply email your pictures to us and we can get them sent out within two working days!

Contact 01439771468 with any questions
